Game Overview

In Tunno Boy, the core idea is straightforward: dive into the enchanting world of Tunno Boy, a captivating 2D platformer. Traverse through eight increasingly difficult levels, deftly collecting magical blue balls. Master the art of double-jumping to outmaneuver vicious enemies and treacherous traps, all while uncovering this vibrant adventure's secrets.
